hooks.name: Coroner commit gate
hooks.description: Before a shell command runs, blocks git commit, git push and git merge when the Coroner certificate of the migration in .kiro/coroner-scope.json replays as ZOMBIE or invalid, or is missing while the audited COBOL or Java file is staged. A git command replays the certificate (measured 3.7 to 9.9 s with the credit-fees scope); any other shell command passes with no replay (0.17 s). Limit: it does not block file writes, and it reads the command only from tool_input.command of the event.
